title: Apex Retail Cloud ERP & Multi-Branch POS
summary: Unified cloud inventory control, high-speed barcode POS billing terminals, and automated financial accounting across 12 physical branches.
problem: Manual inventory reconciliations took 4+ hours daily, with severe stock discrepancies between warehouse and retail outlets, and slow checkout queues.
solution: Built a lightning-fast React + Node.js distributed POS terminal with offline-first billing, central cloud sync, automated low-stock reordering, and instant fiscal tax invoicing.

title: NexGen Logistics & Real-Time Fleet Automation

problem: Manual order assignment caused recurring driver delays, unoptimized fuel routes, and hundreds of daily inbound support calls inquiring 'where is my package?'.

results: 85% decrease in customer support inquiry calls
